'''The Clar system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the astronomical object known as [[the Clar]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Clar system was established in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] which placed it within grid square I-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
